kalkwasserNotes: A settled, covered reservoir of clear kalkwasser can feed a compatible metering pump; a stirring reactor is optional. Dose the clear liquid above the sediment, not powder or slurry, and keep the intake out of settled material. Check the pump maker’s chemical compatibility, tubing and duty limits. Set the amount from measured alkalinity demand, limit daily volume and monitor pH; a low pH reading alone does not establish a need for more kalkwasser.
